project.title: BAKEBOX-AI: AUTONOMOUS AI Bakery Management AND CUSTOMER SUPPORT
project.short_description: Enterprise autonomous AI bakery management and customer engagement platform powered by CHOCO AI — leveraging IBM Db2 hybrid storage (relational ACID tables + native vector search via DB2LlamaVS), LlamaIndex Advanced Hybrid RAG fusing IBM Db2 native dense vectors with BM25 and TF-IDF lexical search via 3-way Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF: k=60), session isolation with conversation buffer memory, in-engine Recursive Bill-of-Materials (BOM) CTE, row-level concurrency locking (SELECT FOR UPDATE WITH RS), cryptographic SHA-256 hash-chained audit trails (BB_AUDIT_LOG), and production FastAPI endpoints.

members.name: Ayush Dhangar
members.role: BTech CSE-AIML, 4th Year | AI Systems & Db2 Solutions Architect

ibm_db2.edition: Db2 Community Edition (Docker / VS Code Extension - IBMDB201)
features_used: In-Database Recursive BOM CTE (Ingredient Recipe Depletion)
Row-Level Concurrency Locking (SELECT FOR UPDATE WITH RS)
3-Way Hybrid RRF Vector Search (DB2LlamaVS + BM25 + TF-IDF)
Native VECTOR(384, FLOAT32) Column via DB2LlamaVS
In-engine Cosine Vector Search via DB2LlamaVS
Relational Transactional Tables (BB_ORDERS, BB_ORDER_ITEMS, BB_CAKES, BB_INVENTORY, BB_RECIPES)
Direct DB-API 2.0 Connection Management with Automatic Commit/Rollback
